activity_statements.statement: operates 890 membership warehouse clubs globally offering a curated selection of nationally-branded and private-label products at low prices
generates significant membership fee revenue by charging annual fees for warehouse access, creating a loyal consumer base
buys merchandise directly from suppliers and routes through cross-docking depot network to warehouses, eliminating middlemen to achieve low prices
operates e-commerce sites in the US, Canada, Mexico, UK, Korea, Taiwan, Japan, and Australia alongside physical warehouse locations
operates gasoline stations at many warehouse locations as an additional member benefit
sells the Kirkland Signature private-label brand across food, beverage, household products, apparel, and other categories

name_reality_gap: Costco's 'Retail' index label is accurate but obscures that a substantial and distinctive part of Costco's revenue model comes from membership fees rather than merchandise margin — it is as much a subscription club as a retailer, and its private-label brand (Kirkland Signature) rivals national brands in scale.
extraction_notes: Costco's main about pages served Akamai CDN shell with no content. 10-K accessed via ExaSearch providing concrete details about warehouse count (890), operating model, and geographic spread.
